question: The Mass Drug Administration Campaign to eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis is being carried out by the Government in around 63 district in 6 states. Which of the following is NOT one of those states? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (13/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Jharkhand
Karnataka
Telangana
Chhattisgarh
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chhattisgarh

Explanation:
The Government of India is conducting the Mass Drug Administration (MDA) campaign to eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis (elephantiasis) in 63 districts across 6 states. These states are: Jharkhand, Karnataka, Telangana, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and West Bengal. Chhattisgarh is not among these states. Under the MDA campaign, tablets of Diethylcarbamazine (DEC) and Albendazole are distributed. The goal is to eliminate filariasis by the year 2030. This campaign is being implemented under the National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP).

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ What is the target year for filariasis elimination? → 2030
☛ Which drugs are given in MDA? → DEC and Albendazole
☛ Which state has the highest number of filariasis cases? → Bihar
☛ Under which ministry does NVBDCP come? → Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

Explanation:

question: Who wrote 'Masterpieces of Vijayanagara Art'?  (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (13/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: RK Narayan
Pranab Chandra Roy
Dr. V Ganapati Sthapati
Dr. Sindigi Rajasekhara
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Dr. Sindigi Rajasekhara

Explanation:
Dr. Sindigi Rajasekhara is a renowned Indian historian and author who has extensively researched the art and culture of the Vijayanagara Empire. His book 'Masterpieces of Vijayanagara Art' provides a detailed description of the masterpieces of sculpture, architecture, and painting from the Vijayanagara period. This book is considered a key reference for the study of Vijayanagara art. The Vijayanagara Empire (1336-1646) was a powerful Hindu empire in South India, known for its rich art and architecture. Dr. Rajasekhara analyzes the art of prominent monuments like the Virupaksha Temple, Hazara Rama Temple, and Vitthala Temple in this book.

solution_hi:

Explanation:

question: Who among the following was the Architect of the 'Basilica of Bom Jesus' in India? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (13/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Erbert Baker and Smith
Julião Simão and Domingos Fernandes
George Wittet and Goerge Bush
William Emerson
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Julião Simão and Domingos Fernandes

Explanation:
The Basilica of Bom Jesus located in Goa, India, was built between 1594 and 1605. Its architects were Julião Simão and Domingos Fernandes, who were of Portuguese origin. question: Who among the following exceptional musicians, unable to complete formal schooling, emerged as a musical genius and innovator, credited with inventing the Trimukhi, Panchamukhi, Saptamukhi, and Navamukhi ragas? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (13/12/2024) Shift 2)

question: The third battle of Panipat was fought between the Maratha Empire and (the) _____. (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (13/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Durrani Empire
Sur Empire
Timurids
Uzbek
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Durrani Empire

Explanation:
The third battle of Panipat was fought on 14 January 1761 between the Maratha Empire and the Durrani Empire led by Ahmad Shah Durrani. This battle was fought for supremacy in North India after the decline of the Mughal Empire. The Marathas were led by Sadashivrao Bhau, while the Durrani army included allies like the Rohillas and Nawab Shuja-ud-Daulah. question: Who among the following developed the notation system for Hindustani classical music? (RRB JE ECE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: Pandit Ravi Shankar
Pandit Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande
Ustad Bismillah Khan
Ustad Amjad Ali Khan
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Pandit Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande

Explanation:
Pandit Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande (1860-1936) developed the standardized notation system for Hindustani classical music. He systematized the theoretical aspects of Indian music and authored a series of books called 'Hindustani Sangeet Paddhati'. His notation system represented notes using syllables (sa, re, ga, ma, pa, dha, ni) and employed symbols for octaves. He also classified numerous ragas and created the 'thaat' system, grouping ragas into 10 parent scales. Bhatkhande founded the Marwar Music College and received the title 'Sangeetacharya'.

question: The glass panel used in greenhouses is known to retain ________. (RRB JE CE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: rainfall

humidity
heat
solution:

Explanation:

question: The Rudra Veena is predominantly associated with which genre of Hindustani music? (RRB JE CE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)

solution:

Explanation:
The Rudra Veena is an ancient Indian string instrument, predominantly associated with the Dhrupad genre of Hindustani classical music. Dhrupad is considered the oldest form of Hindustani music, characterized by solemn, slow compositions.
